decision_clause: The active decision rules out “adding coverage gates or a badge” within `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `pyproject.toml`, and `tests/conftest.py`, because “one workflow that tells the truth is worth more than five nobody reads.”
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The test job still installs and runs pytest as before, but its source-checkout and Python-runtime setup steps now resolve immutable full commit hashes with release-version comments. The scoped files add no coverage collection, coverage threshold enforcement, or coverage badge.
rationale: The implementation only pins two existing GitHub Actions references and preserves the existing test execution. It does not implement either form of the ruled-out approach anywhere within the recorded scope, whose lifecycle remains active.
